readings.Aries: The right thing to do right now involves not doing anything. That's harder for you than most. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Taurus: Your relationship with money is your relationship with security. They are not the same thing. The first instinct was right.
readings.Gemini: The person you've been explaining yourself to doesn't require more explanation. They require presence. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Cancer: You've given your energy to a situation that cannot return it. Time to redirect. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Leo: What you perform eventually becomes what you are. Choose your performance carefully. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Virgo: Your body has been asking for something specific. You've been too busy to answer. Answer it today. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Libra: The beauty you've cultivated around yourself serves you. It also occasionally distracts from what's underneath. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Scorpio: There is something you need to grieve before you can desire again. Let yourself. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Sagittarius: There is a pattern in the places you leave and why. Worth examining before the next departure. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Capricorn: The coldness others perceive is not who you are. It is how you move through uncertain terrain. Let someone know. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Aquarius: You are most difficult when you're most certain. Today, hold your certainty lightly. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Pisces: The dream you had — not the sleeping one — hasn't been attended to in some time. Return to it. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
